{
  "proposed_name": "ble_conn_event_notify",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "summary": "The function looks up a BLE connection slot by handle/index, obtains or posts an internal BLE connection event/message of type 24, fills that event packet with connection state/parameters/subevent type and a timestamp-derived sequence field, and likely sends/notifies the resulting event.",
  "current_name_issue": "`ble_conn_get` is misleading because the body is not merely fetching a connection object; it constructs and notifies/fills a connection event packet.",
  "likely_behavior": [
    "`a1` is used to index a per-connection structure at `dword_119384 + 696 * a1`, so it is probably a connection handle/index.",
    "The byte at offset `+34` selects a secondary BLE slot/context entry in `dword_119370 + 1320 * slot_idx`.",
    "`event_notify(1, 24)` is used to obtain or post an internal BLE event/message of type 24.",
    "The filled packet begins at `*(v11 + 72)` and receives fields including a message/event byte `0x48`, a subevent/status byte of `2` or `1`, connection parameters, addresses, flags, and a timestamp/sequence field.",
    "The branch on `*(v12 + 106) == 2` chooses between two BLE connection event formats/subevent types.",
    "The truncated portion likely finishes packet construction and returns success/failure; `return 1` appears in allocation-failure paths."
  ],
  "alternate_names": [
    "ble_conn_report_event",
    "ble_conn_send_event",
    "ble_conn_evt_notify",
    "ble_conn_get_event"
  ]
}
